title: Dream Crystal Budding Rock
text: Look for blue-violet budding rock on rare Mirror Dream islands. Buds on its faces gradually grow into mature clusters. The budding rock itself cannot be harvested.
Mature clusters yield dream crystals, with Fortune increasing the yield. Silk Touch collects buds or clusters at their current growth stage.
Offering one dream crystal to a Dream Mirror has a 15% chance to yield a placeable budding rock.
